# Split caller publication diagnostic

Observe the actual split caller checks at their construction point. Selected
variants add only the existing source split assertion's subsumption-zero
attribute to those same three commands after translation. Preserve expressions,
original attribute chains, every preparation command, complete post-check
summaries, fuel, ordering and transfers. Native controls retain the original
publication. False-entry controls must remain genuinely Invalid.

This changes which established pieces are available to later checks. It is a
causal diagnostic of a generated-Boogie difference, not a proposal to remove
facts from the product path or a claim of stronger checking. No positive source
hint, new axiom, global fuel policy or body/context-term collection is involved.
